evidence_type: analytical design proposal and periodic interval-union calculation
scope: Digital reference only; biological performance, physical timing and clinical sensing are unvalidated.

verified_parameters: new-IPG command updates as low as25ms, not a complete closed-loop latency
primary_bp.interpretation_caveat: Biphasic 300 us per-phase interpretation and 100 us interphase gap are SCCI_RH modeling assumptions unless separately established from the published waveform; same numerical pulse width does not prove waveform equivalence. Biological equivalence of an aligned alternative is unestablished.

motor_event_spacing.basis: Paced multi-step foot-placement task chosen by Stage 2; multiple axes/contact coordination, not sinusoidal phase alone.

motor_event_error_target.basis: Illustrative task-event scheduling tolerance; not published biological timing tolerance.

sampled_streams.basis: Architecture reference; sampled streams are not physical contact count.

independent_stim_sources.basis: Selected two-driver architecture; four-driver expansion requires fresh electrical, timing, monitoring and power budgets.

maximum_concurrent_sources.basis: Aligned same-frame starts only with independent monitored return paths and qualified cross-coupling.

raw_sample_rate_per_stream.basis: Electronics acquisition reference; fast causal path uses undecimated samples.

acquisition_commands_per_frame.basis: 16 conversions plus pipeline/housekeeping positions; proposed electronics sequence.

acquisition_burst_time.basis: 19 * 3 us; inside a 250 us frame, not added again to every aperture wait.

maximum_channel_aperture_span.basis: 15 * 3 us. Channels carry individual aperture timestamps.

archived_sample_rate_per_stream.basis: Decimated archive/visualization stream; not interchangeable with fast path.

archive_decimator_taps.basis: Causal odd-length FIR at 4000 sample/s; filter coefficients and alias attenuation still require design.

archive_decimator_group_delay.basis: (31-1)/(2*4000); not hidden by relabeling the output timestamps.

core_clock_tick.basis: Chosen sequencer resolution; not oscillator accuracy.

clock_sync_max_interval.basis: 40 ppm worst relative drift over5s=.2ms; plus.3ms mapping residual=.5ms.

clock_map_base_uncertainty.basis: Chosen synchronization-fit error allocation; radio implementation not benchmarked.

clock_conversion_max_uncertainty.basis: Absolute uncertainty used in deadline/freshness admission; reject once unbounded or over allocation.

independent_health_clock_error.basis: Unverified independent timebase assumption; shared failure modes still require analysis.

main_clock_health_detection_deadline.basis: Health-service allocation only; does not bound stuck current duration or substitute for independent electrical protection.

fast_analysis_band_low.basis: Short-history feature candidate range, not proven motor-command information.

afe_highpass_corner.basis: Electronics nominal first-order HP reference; slow content retained with large low-frequency group delay.

afe_lowpass_corner.basis: Electronics nominal third-order Butterworth LP reference.

fast_afe_group_delay_allocation.basis: 20–300Hz allocation. Circuit-specific transfer, nonlinear recovery and actual feature filtering still require checks.

motor_feature_history.basis: Trailing finite history, no future data. Recursive state may also use older history with explicit age.

motor_feature_tick.basis: 200Hz estimator/policy dispatch; release phase wait included once.

uniform_history_representative_age.basis: 20ms uniform weights midpoint only. Invalid masks or different filters change the actual age.

motor_latest_valid_sample_max_age.basis: Admission freshness gate; clock uncertainty included. Passing does not prove observability.

motor_max_contiguous_observation_gap.basis: Chosen qualification threshold; not a physiological constant.

motor_minimum_global_usable_fraction.basis: Chosen screening gate; sufficient information must still be demonstrated by later held-out decoder tests.

motor_minimum_usable_fraction_per_histor.basis: Chosen gate applies per20ms trailing window, not just average duty.

motor_goal_pre_admission_lead.basis: Known paced task goal can be scheduled in advance; this is not future observed body state.

motor_predictive_horizon_max.basis: Chosen maximum for qualified learner response predictions; no fallback to hidden truth.

external_foot_contact_sample_rate.basis: Chosen external reference for contact events; modality/accuracy still unresolved.

external_motion_filter_delay_allocation.basis: Chosen sensor-processing allowance; must later be qualified.

external_motion_transport_deadline.basis: Chosen physical-sample-to-Core transport component after local sensor/filtering; implementation unresolved.

external_motion_latest_sample_max_age.basis: 5ms sample wait+2ms sensor filtering+5ms transport; clock uncertainty is added to upper-age check.

stimulus_preguard.basis: Chosen global recording-mask lead before planned first phase; unexpected delivery also needs clipping/monitor validity detection.

stimulus_interphase_gap.basis: SCCI_RH waveform choice, not automatically the primary paper waveform.

pulse_phase_edge_error_allocation.basis: Chosen scheduled phase-duration error allocation; hardware/independent watchdog qualification pending.

pulse_start_jitter_allocation.basis: Launch jitter allocation distinct from phase-duration error.

sbp_nominal_beat_interval.basis: Chosen artificial physiology nominal60beats/min; not a publisher sensor or link latency.

sbp_beat_interval_range.basis: 40–120beats/min timing stress; arrhythmia is invalid separately.

sbp_control_tick.basis: Chosen4Hz local policy service. New physiological observation remains beat-derived; no invented four fresh beats/s.

sbp_waveform_reference_sample_rate.status: primary-methods precedent; not certified SCCI_RH sensor performance
sbp_waveform_reference_sample_rate.basis: Phillips2025 Hemodynamic monitoring: calibrated finger plethysmography, brachial pressure sampled200Hz; SCCI_RH external sensor remains unselected.

sbp_beat_closure_max_delay.basis: Chosen artificial model allowance only; physical peak-to-extracted-value latency in the selected clinical sensor is unresolved. Add any1Hz resampling/extraction wait explicitly.

sbp_transport_max_delay.basis: Chosen extraction-to-Core arrival allowance; no source claim.

sbp_max_peak_timestamp_age.basis: Age measured from physical systolic peak plus clock uncertainty, never packet arrival.

sbp_gap_detection_period.basis: Chosen service check; latest valid beat age crossing2s gates new adaptation.

radio_motor_plan_lease.basis: Finite authenticated session-plan horizon; local observation-health gates still apply.

radio_bp_support_lease.basis: Maximum committed support authorization. No indefinite last-command replay; not a clinical fallback recommendation.

local_bp_stale_fallback_duration.basis: Digital studies compare bounded hold/ramp/down/stop consequences; no autonomous human fallback is authorized.

bp_clinical_sensor_accuracy.status: unresolved; sensor selection and clinical validation required
bp_clinical_sensor_accuracy.basis: Synthetic noise/bias cases are not clinical measurement specifications.

independent_electrical_trip_latency.status: owned by electrical/monitor budget; pending later qualification
independent_electrical_trip_latency.basis: Must derive from current, charge, compliance and stuck-output envelopes, not main-clock-health deadline.

reference_compute_clock.basis: nRF5340 application-core performance allocation while the independent delivery-monitor stream is active. Oscillator accuracy is a different parameter.

sbp_extracted_update_rate.status: primary-methods precedent selected for digital reference
sbp_extracted_update_rate.basis: Phillips2025 reports SBP/DBP/MAP extraction1Hz. This does not establish exact age, extraction method or four fresh observations/s when controller ticks4Hz.

sbp_peak_to_extraction_resampling_wait.status: chosen possible asynchronous1Hz extraction phase wait
sbp_peak_to_extraction_resampling_wait.basis: If1Hz extractor publishes the latest completed beat, this adds to physical peak age; do not hide it in arrival timestamp.

filter_delay_examples.method: Analytic small-signal group delay, not step response or learned feature latency. HP tau_g=fc/[2*pi*(f^2+fc^2)]; LP delay is sum of stable Butterworth-pole contributions.
filter_delay_examples.consequence: At1Hz a20ms window is .02cycles; no general phase/intent identifiability follows. Separate slow-context estimation and qualification; future samples never repair freshness.

latency_analysis.status: Analytical allocations; compute times are not measured MCU or host benchmarks.

fast_unframed_chain.type: aperture phase wait;57us conversion burst inside frame
Includes conversion/pipeline return, DMA and bounded buffer-release wait; not added a second time to frame phase
periodic release wait; shared for feature and policy

event_anchored_schedule.requirement: Only launch at target timestamp if20ms pre-admission, valid prediction/freshness, route/monitor health, per-profile minimum periods and physical-source service bounds all hold.
event_anchored_schedule.prohibition: Cannot evade refractory/output-frequency budget by resetting frame phase. If a source just pulsed, defer or reject.
event_anchored_schedule.limitation: Known future goal time is available; future body state is not. Event scheduling does not establish correct biological response timing.

pipeline_notes: AFE acquisition and accumulation stream continuously.20ms rolling history is not re-collected on every tick.
19-command57us burst is within the250us frame; do not add both frame and a full second conversion burst.
The5ms periodic release allowance is shared by the estimator/policy dispatch; no second5ms wait unless implementation introduces one.
Shorter blocks, concurrency or overlapped DMA change a later measured schedule only; do not subtract unverified parallelism.
Representative history age and group delay describe information age. Queue/compute delay describes execution. Report both without calling all history warm-up a repeated hardware latency.
Reaction to an event first obscured by a blank may incur another observation-gap wait. Freshness/coverage can reject before deadline; it must not interpolate hidden state.

external_motion_example.status: chosen allowances only; field sensor and wireless timing unmeasured
external_motion_example.comparison_rule: Report native-latency and latency-matched sensing comparisons. An extra sensor advantage caused only by preferential timing is not evidence that its neural content is uniquely useful.

pressure_observation_examples.consequence: The assumed envelope can violate2s freshness. It does not close simply because extraction is1Hz. Sensor must timestamp/bound true measurement support, reduce delays, or trigger declared stale fallback; actual clinical delay remains unresolved.

artifact_analysis.evidence_type: Analytic periodic interval union; no new simulation trial or measured recovery.
artifact_analysis.equation: For every electricalevent tj, invalid interval=[tj-preguard, tj+2*phase_width+interphase+recovery]. Computeunion over periodic train, includingwrap-around; fraction=unionlength/period.
artifact_analysis.global_mask: All16 streams conservatively invalid during affected intervals. Spatial isolation/per-channel recovery can reduce this only after evidence.
artifact_analysis.same_time_drivers: Two truly synchronized independent drivers share one global mask interval, not two. Independent delivered edge times must later confirm alignment.
artifact_analysis.different_time_drivers: Staggered events create distinct intervals whose union may overlap. Never double-count overlapping intervals or ignore additional events.
artifact_analysis.polarity: Biphasic symmetric commanded widths do not prove delivered charge balance; monitor evidence is separate.
artifact_analysis.discretization: Continuous-time occupancy is optimistic for valid sample counts. At4kHz mark every actual aperture inside union; include clock/edge/recovery uncertainty and channel skew. No rounded table passes that discrete validity check by itself.
artifact_analysis.qualification: Recovery values are sensitivity inputs, not claims that AFE recovers in that duration. Saturation/headroom and recovery-validity evidence control mask end.
conclusions: Traveling wave120Hz300us per-phase reference has no continuous fast-estimator gate pass for any tested0.5/1/3/5ms recovery with100us preguard.
120Hz aligned alternative is not proven biologically equivalent to0/2/4ms traveling wave.
Motor60Hz500us phases3ms recovery passes average65% coverage but fails worst20ms window coverage.
Motor5ms recovery fails5ms contiguous-gap gate even when average coverage exceeds65%.
External SBP feedback may remain available while all spinal channels are blanked; added neural biomarker availability must be explicit.
